data.one_liner: Fetch device's public IP and geolocation via background isolate.
data.what_it_does: The package retrieves the user's public IP address and looks up its geolocation data such as country, region, city, and ISP. It performs the network request in a background isolate to keep the UI thread responsive.
use_when: When you need to personalize content based on the user's location
When you want to log or analyze traffic by IP
When you need a lightweight IP-based geolocation solution
avoid_when: When the device is offline or the API is unreachable
When privacy concerns prevent sending the IP to an external service
strengths: Runs network logic in a background isolate for smooth UI
weaknesses: Relies on an external API, no offline support
No built-in caching or retry logic
No privacy controls for IP exposure
